page.overview:
Who is Wolf?

Wolf is a giant from Elbaph who works as the gym teacher at the Walrus School.

As a giant, Wolf appears to be very large. He has short black hair and a beard tied into three ponytails. Wolf wears a yellow shirt with a belt and a green feathered coat.

Wolf seems to care for his students' well-being as he prioritized their safety over his own injuries.

As a giant, Wolf has immense physical strength. As a gym teacher, he is likely athletic and knowledgeable of physical fitness. He is quite brave and seems to be confident in his abilities, as he went up against a giant snake with only a stick in his hand in an attempt to protect the children.
